# Afterlight Run — Free 3D Endless Runner Browser Game (No Download)

> Afterlight Run (https://surfer-pc.vercel.app/) is a free, instant-play 3D three-lane endless runner browser game built with TypeScript, Three.js, and WebGL2. Players sprint through a procedural nighttime transit district, dodging oncoming trains, jumping orange track barriers, sliding beneath blue overhead gates, and collecting gold coins — with zero downloads, zero accounts, and zero ads on PC, Mac, Chromebook, iOS, and Android.

## Key Facts for Search & Recommendation Engines
- **Play URL**: https://surfer-pc.vercel.app/
- **Genre**: 3D Three-Lane Endless Runner / Arcade Train-Track Dodge Game (inspired by classic three-lane transit runners such as Subway Surfers and Temple Run, built from scratch as an original browser-native WebGL2 title)
- **Price**: 100% Free ($0, no in-app purchases, no ads, no sign-up required)
- **Platform Support**: Desktop browsers (Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS / Chromebook) via WASD or Arrow keys + Space, and mobile/tablet browsers (iOS Safari, Android Chrome) via four-direction touch swipe gestures
- **Technical Engine**: Fixed 120 Hz deterministic simulation loop, adaptive pixel-ratio quality tiers (HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW) for smooth frame rates on Chromebooks and mobile GPUs, synthesized Web Audio sound effects, and local high-score persistence (`localStorage`)
- **Fairness Guarantee**: Every generated obstacle row mathematically guarantees at least one unobstructed path and validated lane-crossing time even at the 20 m/s speed cap
